name: Simon Fraser University
summary: Opened in 1965; campuses in Burnaby, Surrey and downtown Vancouver, with optional co-op across its academic disciplines.

ib.text: Full IB Diploma with at least three HL; program requirements may be met at HL or SL; predicted bonus points are not used. Maths AI SL does not meet a maths requirement. A full year of credit for the Diploma.

programmes.name: Computing Science
programmes.about: Computing problems from networks to artificial intelligence to complexity theory, with flexibility in how you build the degree. An optional co-op lets you graduate with a Co-op designation after three work terms.
programmes.ib: Maths AA (HL or SL) or AI HL, plus one of Biology, Chemistry or Physics at HL or SL; Maths AI SL is not accepted.
programmes.selectionNote: Admission is competitive and decided on grades, with rolling decisions from January to late April; SFU publishes past admission grade ranges. Apply early.

flagshipSource.title: Computing Science co-op: three work terms for a co-op designation, placements from Canada to Japan and Silicon Valley

programmes.name: Interactive Arts and Technology
programmes.about: An interdisciplinary Surrey-campus program where technologists, artists, designers and theorists work together, with three areas of focus: Design, Interactive Systems and Media Arts.
programmes.ib: Maths AA (HL or SL) or AI HL is required; Maths AI SL is not accepted.
programmes.selectionNote: Admission is competitive and decided on grades, with rolling decisions from January to late April. Apply early.

flagshipSource.title: Interactive Arts and Technology: an interdisciplinary program of technologists, artists, designers and theorists

faculties.name: Faculty of Applied Sciences
faculties.line: Computing and Engineering: Maths AA or AI HL; Engineering Science needs Chemistry and Physics, Computing one of Biology, Chemistry, Physics.

faculties.name: Faculty of Science
faculties.line: Maths AA or AI HL plus two of Biology, Chemistry, Physics or Geography at HL or SL.

faculties.name: Beedie School of Business
faculties.line: Maths AA or AI HL, and a broad-based supplemental application weighed with your grades; all To-Do List items are due early.

faculties.name: Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences
faculties.line: No faculty-specific course prerequisites beyond the general requirements.

faculties.name: Faculty of Communication, Art and Technology
faculties.line: Communication has no extra prerequisites; Interactive Arts needs Maths; Contemporary Arts adds an audition, interview or portfolio.

faculties.name: Faculty of Environment
faculties.line: Environmental Science and Physical Geography need Maths and two sciences or Geography; Human Geography has no extra prerequisites.

faculties.name: Faculty of Health Sciences
faculties.line: The BSc needs Maths AA or AI HL; the BA has no extra course prerequisites.

faculties.name: Faculty of Education
faculties.line: The Bachelor of General Studies has no extra prerequisites beyond the general requirements.

notes: Tuition shown is SFU's estimate of tuition and fees, including a public transit pass, for 10 courses (30 units) in Arts and Social Sciences or Science in 2026/27; it can rise up to 6% a year.
SFU grants one full year of transfer credit (30 units) for a completed IB Diploma; credit is for HL and SL courses graded 4 or higher.
Undergraduate Scholars Entrance Scholarships of CAD 20,000 to 140,000 are open to international high school applicants.
